extracted.name: Simple chocolate sauce
extracted.description: Melt chocolate and mix with cream, sugar and a glug of almond liqueur, if you like, to create a decadent sauce
instruction_lines: Melt the chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of simmering water until completely smooth. Or, melt in 20-second bursts in the microwave.
Add the butter, cream and sugar to the melted chocolate, and stir to combine until smooth. Serve warm over chocolate pudding or vanilla ice cream.
